company: Future Generation Joint Venture (Webuild, Clough, Lane)
title: Draftsperson - Junior (Snowy 2.0)
content_text: Webuild careers (FGJV, Snowy 2.0), Draftsperson - Junior, Cooma NSW, dated 8 Oct 2026. Purpose: produce accurate technical drawings for civil structures and systems on Snowy 2.0, support shop drawings, identify design or construction issues. Qualifications: Diploma or certificate in drafting, civil engineering, or related field; White Card. Experience: Minimum 2 years of experience in civil drafting, preferably in large-scale infrastructure or hydro projects within multidisciplinary teams. Competencies: AutoCAD and BIM tools such as Revit, Revizto, Tekla or Navisworks; read and interpret drawings; AS1100; civil construction methods. Duties: construction drawings for dams, tunnels, intake structures; revise from markups; drawing logs and document control; basic quantity take-offs and bar list checks. Remote, extreme cold conditions.
apply_instructions: Apply through the Webuild careers portal link on the advert.
